notes.title: Update 1.5 + Android
notes.content:
[h2]CONTENT[/h2]

Improvement
- Land forces move replay.
- Simple statistics on multiplayer games.
- Cavalry charge and French Imperial guard battle options are not proposed if the battle ratio is 4:1 as they will be pointless.
- Waterloo: the restriction on French moves during first turn has been lifted.
- Some land units wear a pre-Empire uniform for early scenarios.

Grand Campaign
- A leader is needed to load infantry on naval transport
- To enforce a naval blockade, you must achieve at least squadron parity.

[h2]THE GAME COMES ON ANDROID...[/h2]

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.AvalonDigital.WarAndPeaceBETA]See on Google Play Store[/url]

Minimum requirements: Android 12, > 4 GB RAM

notes.title: Update 1.3.5
notes.content:
[h3]NAME CHANGE[/h3]
Game name changed to [b]Napoleon's Eagles[/b], following a Trademark infringement complaint that was received without warning. Due to this, we are forced not to use Mark’s 40+ years well-known product name [i]'War & Peace'[/i], as his brand was only registered by Avalon Hill and him as a boardgame and not as a computer game. 

[h3]NEW[/h3]
[b]New attrition rule[/b] as an option.
- Instead of a global die-roll, you may opt for a local die-roll (one die per color and per map area).
- Activate it as a module before starting a new game

[b]Sticky Options[/b]:
- when you start a scenario, all previously selected options for the same scenario are selected by default.

[h3]FIXES[/h3]
[b]Miscellaneous fixes[/b]
- Removed the lead-time on the rules menu
- Removed cheating possibility on siege die-rolls.
- Better supply check
- Attrition tutorial
- The number of actions on the map button has been removed as too irrelevant

notes.title: December Update
notes.content:
[h3]Content[/h3]
1807 scenario is playable against AI.

Spain has 2 unnamed leaders to replace any casualty.

The land combat loss table is reachable form the land battle view.

[h3]Technical upgrade[/h3]
[list]
[*] This will ease the game maintenance.
[*] You should expect a faster loading time between different games. Music is better managed.
[*] This has opened new possibilities for multiplayer games
[*] Better performance for the Alliance view.
[/list]
[h3]Multi-player[/h3]
[list]
[*] After giving the hand to the opponent, the program periodically checks if it is your turn to play.
[*] A Next button invites to play your turn on another ongoing game.
[*] You jump to next game or refresh current game state after your opponent’s turn without going back to the main menu.
[*] Email notifications are only sent after 1/2h if you haven’t played your turn.
[/list]

notes.title: WAR & PEACE 1.1
notes.content:
The this [b]major update[/b] will have at least the following scope:
[list]
[*] AI for Waterloo scenario
[*] Land movement replay feature so that you may see what has done AI or your opponent on his last movement phase.
[*] Performance supply, movement
[*] Possibility to surrender a 2P-game directly from the saved game tile which allows to delete the game afterwards.
[*] Possibility to review battle result at the force’s level.
[/list]

Also included with direct Steam access the updated PDF guide`
- Calibri font
- Searchable text
- Added more tables
- Miscellaneous fixes
